definition_zh: n. 码头；船坞；被告席 v. 靠码头；进港；剪短；扣除
definition_en: a place where ships load, repair or stand trial, or to bring a ship in, cut a part off, or deduct money
core_image: 一条用粗缆绳系在石砌码头边的船身；一条架在墩木上停在空水池里的船；一个面向高台的木栏小隔间；一张被红笔划掉一行的工资单
scene: 渡轮贴上石砌码头，缆绳套上了系船柱。 The ferry docked at noon.
sceneCN: 这里 dock 是「靠码头」（第 4 个义项：把船开进码头）；句意：渡轮中午靠岸。图中可辨识物件：渡轮、石砌码头、系船柱、粗缆绳。

senses.title: A ship berth
senses.definition: an enclosed area of water where ships load and unload
senses.definitionCN: （名词）供船只装卸货物的封闭水域
senses.example: The ship waited at the dock for a berth.
senses.exampleCN: 船在码头等泊位。
senses.why: A hull tied to a stone quay with thick ropes.
senses.whyCN: 一条用粗缆绳系在石砌码头边的船身。

senses.title: A repair yard
senses.definition: a place where ships are built or repaired
senses.definitionCN: （名词）造船或修船的地方
senses.example: The tanker went into dry dock for repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 油轮进干船坞修理。
senses.why: A ship resting on blocks in an empty basin.
senses.whyCN: 一条架在墩木上、停在空水池里的船。

senses.title: The trial place
senses.definition: the enclosed place where the accused stands in court
senses.definitionCN: （名词）法庭上被告站立的围栏区域
senses.example: He stood in the dock and said nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 他站在被告席上一言不发。
senses.why: A wooden rail box facing a raised bench.
senses.whyCN: 一个面向高台的木栏小隔间。

senses.title: Bring a ship in
senses.definition: to bring or take a ship into a dock
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把船开进或引进码头
senses.example: The ferry docked at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮中午靠岸。
senses.why: A rope looping over a bollard as the hull touches the quay.
senses.whyCN: 船身贴上码头时缆绳套上系船柱。

senses.title: Cut a part off
senses.definition: to cut off part of something, such as the tail of an animal
senses.definitionCN: （动词）剪掉某物的一部分，例如动物的尾巴
senses.example: The vet docked the tail of the lamb.
senses.exampleCN: 兽医剪短了羔羊的尾巴。
senses.why: A short tail stub beside a pair of shears.
senses.whyCN: 一把剪刀旁的一截短尾桩。

senses.title: Take money off
senses.definition: to deduct an amount from wages or a payment
senses.definitionCN: （动词）从工资或款项中减去一笔钱
senses.example: They docked his pay for the lost hours.
senses.exampleCN: 他们扣了他误工时数的工资。
senses.why: A payslip with one line crossed through in red.
senses.whyCN: 一张工资单，其中一行被红笔划掉。

intro.en: Dock comes from Middle Dutch docke, a channel or watercourse: first the water where a ship lies, then the quay beside it, then the railed box in court that looks like a small pen.
intro.cn: dock 来自中古荷兰语 docke「水道、沟渠」：先指船停的那片水，再指旁边的码头，后来法庭上那个像小围栏的被告席也叫这个名字。

items.en: Middle Dutch docke means a channel or watercourse.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 docke 意为水道或沟渠。

items.en: A related Low German word names a harbour basin.
items.cn: 相关的低地德语词指港口水池。

items.en: English dock first names the water where ships lie.
items.cn: 英语 dock 最初指船只停泊的水域。

items.en: The verb means to bring a ship into dock.
items.cn: 动词意为把船引进码头。

items.en: The word comes to name the enclosure for the accused.
items.cn: 这个词转而指被告所在的围栏区。

items.en: Dock also means to cut short or to deduct.
items.cn: dock 也指剪短或扣除。

note.en: Dock is where a ship lies still; its look-alikes share the stem or the ship setting, and its neighbours name other structures at the water edge.
note.cn: dock 是船停住的地方；形近词共用词干或同属船上场景，近义词则是水边别的构筑物。

dict_mnemonic.text: dock 先指「船停的那片水」，于是有了码头、船坞；法庭上被告站的那块围栏也像个小池子，便叫「被告席」。动词一面是「把船开进来」，一面是「把多余的一截去掉」——剪尾巴、扣工资都是去掉一截。

root: 中古荷兰语 docke（水道）→ 中古英语 dok（船停的水域）→ 英语 dock（码头；船坞；被告席；靠泊；扣除）

intro.en: Dock builds docker with -er, dockyard with -yard and dockage with -age; un- reverses the action in undock.
intro.cn: dock 用 -er 造出 docker，用 -yard 造出 dockyard，用 -age 造出 dockage；un- 在 undock 里把动作反过来。

latinIntro.en: Latin portus means a harbour or gate; the English dock stem itself comes from Middle Dutch, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 portus 意为港口或门；英语 dock 这个词干来自中古荷兰语，不是拉丁语。

definition_zh: 实施；执行；进行；完成；履行；把……搬出去
definition_en: to perform or complete a plan, a task, an order or an action, or literally to move something out of a place
core_image: 工头把图纸摊在钢梁上，一名工人照着编号逐段加固，另一名在旁边把已完成的项一格一格打勾
scene: 旧厂房里，工人按图纸逐项施工，监理拿着清单在旁边核对每一项是否真的落实。 The crew will carry out the reinforcement exactly as the drawing shows.
sceneCN: 这里指按计划实施加固工程（第 1 个义项：把既定方案真正做出来）；句意为施工队将完全照图纸实施加固。图中可辨识物件：钢梁、图纸、打勾清单、扭矩扳手。

pos.zh: 实施；执行；进行（及物动词短语，宾语多为计划、研究、命令、任务）
把……搬出去（字面义，宾语为可移动的物件）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加表示施事者的词尾构成，义为「承运者；载体」
由动词加表示行为或工具的名词尾构成，义为「运输；车厢」
由动词加动名词词尾构成，义为「搬运；承载的」
由动词加「可……的」词尾构成，义为「便于携带的」

senses.title: Put a plan into effect
senses.definition: to perform a planned piece of work from start to finish
senses.definitionCN: 把一项已规划的工作从头到尾做出来
senses.example: The city will carry out the drainage project in two stages.
senses.exampleCN: 该市将分两个阶段实施排水工程。
senses.why: The verb meant to move something along, and a plan is carried until it stands completed rather than only written.
senses.whyCN: 核心动词本义是「把某物搬运向前」，计划被「搬」到完工为止，而不是停在纸面上。

senses.title: Conduct a study
senses.definition: to perform a systematic inquiry or measurement
senses.definitionCN: 开展系统的调查或测量
senses.example: The team must carry out a survey of every household in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 该团队必须对河谷中的每一户进行调查。
senses.why: A survey is carried outward into every household until the plan stands completed.
senses.whyCN: 调查被搬到每一户人家，直到计划完成。

senses.title: Fulfil a promise or an order
senses.definition: to act on a commitment or an instruction that has been given
senses.definitionCN: 把已作出的承诺或已下达的指示做出来
senses.example: Officers should carry out the order even when they doubt its wisdom.
senses.exampleCN: 即使对命令是否明智存疑，官员也应执行该命令。
senses.why: An order is only words until it is carried outward into action.
senses.whyCN: 命令在被搬进行动之前只是话。

senses.title: Complete a task to the end
senses.definition: to finish a piece of work rather than leave it partly done
senses.definitionCN: 把一件工作做完，而不是半途停下
senses.example: Volunteers can carry out the whole restoration in a single summer.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者可以在一个夏天内完成整个修复工作。
senses.why: The outward push ends only when the last piece is finished.
senses.whyCN: 向外的推力直到最后一件做完才停止。

senses.title: Mount a military action
senses.definition: to perform a raid, an attack or a patrol as a unit
senses.definitionCN: 以部队为单位实施突袭、攻击或巡逻
senses.example: The patrol may carry out a raid on the depot before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 巡逻队可能在黎明前对仓库实施突袭。
senses.why: A unit carries an action outward beyond its own lines.
senses.whyCN: 部队把行动搬到自己防线之外。

senses.title: Remove something physically
senses.definition: literally to take an object out of a room or a building
senses.definitionCN: 字面地把物件从房间或建筑中搬走
senses.example: Two workers will carry out the broken crates before the floor is washed.
senses.exampleCN: 两名工人会在洗地之前把破木箱搬出去。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer of the phrase: the object is carried and the direction is outward.
senses.whyCN: 这是短语最古老的一层：物件被搬动，方向朝外。

senses.title: Make a threat real
senses.definition: to actually do what one has warned others one would do
senses.definitionCN: 真的做出此前警告过要做的事
senses.example: He may carry out his threat to publish the letters.
senses.exampleCN: 他可能真的兑现公布那些信件的威胁。
senses.why: A threat becomes real only when it is carried out into the act it named.
senses.whyCN: 威胁只有在被搬成它所说的那个行动时才变真。

senses.title: Apply a reform at every level
senses.definition: to put a new rule into practice through every level of an organisation
senses.definitionCN: 使新规则在组织的每一层都落到实处
senses.example: Local offices must carry out the new rules without adding their own conditions.
senses.exampleCN: 地方办事处必须执行新规则，不得自行附加条件。
senses.why: A rule is carried outward through every office until the last one acts on it.
senses.whyCN: 规则被搬到每一个办事处，直到最后一个也照它行事。

senses.title: Execute a commercial transaction
senses.definition: to complete a sale or an order in a market
senses.definitionCN: 在市场里完成一笔买卖或订单
senses.example: The broker will carry out the sale at the opening price.
senses.exampleCN: 经纪人将按开盘价执行这笔卖出。
senses.why: A trade is carried to its close when the order is executed at the stated price.
senses.whyCN: 交易在按约定价格执行时被搬到终点。

intro.en: The phrase pairs a verb that reached English from the language of carters with a native particle of direction. What is carried out is moved from inside to outside, and the figurative senses keep that outward push.
intro.cn: 这个短语把经赶车人之语进入英语的动词，与本族表示方向的虚词配在一起。被「搬出去」的东西由内到外，比喻义也保留这股向外的推力。

items.en: A Gaulish word for a wheeled cart was taken into Latin as carrus, and it stands behind carriage, cargo and career.
items.cn: 高卢语中表示带轮车子的词被拉丁语吸收，马车、货物与「生涯」诸词都由它而来。

items.en: Carricare meant to load a cart, and it produced the verb that French reshaped as carier, to carry.
items.cn: 这个词意为「把货装上车」，由此产生的动词被法语改写成「运送」。

items.en: English took the verb through the northern French form in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪经北方法语的形式引入这个动词。

items.en: The particle is native English and means outward or away from the inside; it gives the phrase its direction.
items.cn: 虚词是本族英语，意为「向外、离开里面」，为短语提供了方向。

items.en: The combination first appears in the sixteenth century with the literal sense, and the sense of performing a plan follows. The exact first citation is uncertain, and the deeper origin of the cart word is not established.
items.cn: 这个组合在十六世纪先以字面义出现，随后才有「实施计划」的意思。最早书证年代不确定；表示「车」的那个词更早的来源亦无定论。

note.en: The first group shares the carrying verb with a different particle each time; the second group holds verbs of performing a task.
note.cn: 第一组共享「搬运」动词，但各自的虚词不同；第二组是表示「执行任务」的动词。

entries.definition: The bare verb needs a concrete object and no direction, as carry a bag; it says nothing about completing a plan.
entries.definitionCN: 单独使用时带具体宾语，如提一个包，不含方向，也不表示完成计划。

entries.definition: It means to continue rather than to perform; the particle points forward in time, not outward.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「继续」，而不是「执行」；虚词指时间上的向前，而非向外。

entries.definition: It means to complete something despite difficulty, close to the fourth sense but with an added note of endurance.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「排除困难坚持完成」，接近第四个义项，但多了一层「撑住」的意味。

entries.definition: It means to transfer something to another period or account, a movement across, not an execution.
entries.definitionCN: 意为把某物结转到另一期或另一账目，是横向转移，不是执行。

entries.definition: A formal verb for making a policy or system operate; it stresses the machinery of putting something into effect.
entries.definitionCN: 正式地表示使政策或制度运转，强调「使之生效」的机制。

entries.definition: The usual verb for running a study, a survey or an orchestra; it fits research better than repairs.
entries.definitionCN: 常用于「进行研究、调查或指挥乐队」，用于研究比用于维修更合适。

entries.definition: A formal verb for performing a plan or a legal act; it also carries the separate meaning of putting someone to death.
entries.definitionCN: 正式地表示执行计划或法律行为；另有「处死」这一不相干的含义。

entries.definition: A general verb for doing a task or a role; it lacks the sense of completing something previously planned.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指完成任务或扮演角色，不含「把既定计划做完」之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the reinforcement drawing, the household survey, the order on the desk and the crates by the door.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用加固图纸、入户调查、桌上的命令与门边的木箱四个场景。

normal.en: A drawing on a steel beam, a torque wrench, and a checklist filling with ticks.
normal.cn: 钢梁上摊着图纸，扭矩扳手转动，清单上的勾一格一格填满。

normal.en: One survey sheet for every household in the valley.
normal.cn: 河谷里每户一张调查表。

normal.en: An order signed at the top, carried out before the ink is dry.
normal.cn: 命令签在顶端，墨迹未干就已经执行。

normal.en: Broken crates carried out before the floor is washed.
normal.cn: 洗地之前，先把破木箱搬出去。

normal.en: A threat that stops being words and becomes an act.
normal.cn: 威胁不再只是话，而变成了一件事。

abstract.en: A plan is only a sentence until someone carries it out.
abstract.cn: 计划在有人执行之前，只是一句话。

abstract.en: The same phrase moves a box and a reform, because both travel from intention to fact.
abstract.cn: 同一个短语既搬箱子也推改革，因为两者都从意图走到事实。

abstract.en: Execution is where authority meets material: nothing survives the trip unchanged.
abstract.cn: 执行是权威与材料相遇的地方：经过这趟搬运，没有东西原样不变。

examples.en: The laboratory will carry out the tests under a sealed protocol.
examples.cn: 实验室将按封存的规程进行这些测试。

examples.en: Local councils must carry out the housing survey before winter.
examples.cn: 地方议会必须在入冬前完成住房调查。

examples.en: A promise is easy to make and harder to carry out.
examples.cn: 承诺容易作出，却难以履行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「凯瑞 奥特」：把「搬出去」记成工人把箱子从屋里抬到门外——搬到底，事情就算做完

root: 核心动词经古法语来自晚期拉丁语「把货物装上车」，其源头是高卢语中表示「车」的词，更早来源不确定；虚词为本族英语，意为「向外」。短语整体表示「把某事从计划搬到完成」，也保留字面的「搬出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses move outward: a plan, a study, an order, a task, a raid, a crate, a threat, a reform at every level, and a sale.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都朝外推：计划、研究、命令、任务、突袭、木箱、威胁、层层落实的改革与一笔交易。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drawing laid on a steel beam, a wrench turning, and a checklist filling with ticks as the work moves outward to completion.
core.cn: 核心意象：图纸摊在钢梁上，扳手转动，清单随工程推进被一格格打勾，直到完成。

branches.en: THE PLAN AND THE LEVELS: a project or a rule must be performed from the top down to the last office.
branches.cn: 计划与层级：工程或规则必须从上到下落到最后一个办事处。

branches.en: THE FIELD ACTION: a survey in every household, a raid before dawn.
branches.cn: 现场行动：逐户调查，黎明突袭。

branches.en: THE BINDING WORD: an order obeyed, a threat finally acted on.
branches.cn: 有约束的话：命令被服从，威胁终于变成行动。

branches.en: THE CLOSED DEAL: the restoration finished, the sale executed at the opening price.
branches.cn: 完成的交易：修复完工，卖出按开盘价执行。

branches.en: THE LITERAL BOX: crates taken out before the floor is washed.
branches.cn: 字面的箱子：洗地之前把木箱搬出去。

intro.en: The family joins a borrowed cart word to native English endings; the particle carries direction while the endings carry agent, act and capacity.
intro.cn: 这个词族把借来的「车」之词与本族英语词尾结合；方向由虚词承担，施事、动作与能力由词尾承担。

latinIntro.en: Latin carrus came from Gaulish, and its verb carricare passed through French into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的「车」来自高卢语，其动词经法语进入英语。

items.example: The borrowed noun at the base of the family.
It produced the verb of carrying.
The English verb at the centre of the phrase.
It forms the word for a carrier.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「承运者」的词。

items.example: It forms the noun for transport and its price.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示运输及其费用的名词。

items.example: It forms the participle of the phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它构成短语的现在分词。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加施事词尾构成，义为「承运者」
由动词加名词尾构成，义为「运输；车厢」
由动词加动名词词尾构成，义为「搬运；承载的」
由动词加「可……的」词尾构成，义为「便于携带的」

definition_zh: 氏族；大家族；帮派团伙；游戏中的公会
definition_en: a group of people who claim descent from a common ancestor and act as one social unit, or a close group with a shared interest
core_image: 一群人围在一起清点祖先的名字，把家谱铺在桌上。
scene: 山脚下的老屋里，族人围坐，把家谱铺在桌上，逐代念出祖先的名字并核对辈分。 The elders of the clan keep the genealogy in a wooden chest and read it aloud at every wedding.
sceneCN: 这里 clan 指「共享祖先、以血缘联结的氏族」（第 1 个义项：以共同祖先为纽带的群体）；句意为族中长者把族谱收在木箱里，每逢婚礼就当众诵读。可辨识物件：家谱、木箱、老屋、围坐的族人。

derivatives.zh: clan + -ish（形容词后缀）→ 抱团排外的，语义落在群体内部的紧密与排他
clannish + -ly（副词后缀）→ 以抱团排外的方式，语义仅改词性
clannish + -ness（名词后缀）→ 抱团排外的性质，语义抽象化为品质
clan + 连接成分 -s + man（人）→ 同氏族成员，语义落在成员身份
clan + -ship（状态后缀）→ 氏族归属与氏族制度，语义由群体转为制度

senses.title: A group tracing one ancestor
senses.definition: a social unit whose members claim descent from a common ancestor and recognize shared obligations
senses.definitionCN: 成员自称出自同一祖先、并承认相互义务的社会单位
senses.example: The whole clan gathers at the ancestral hall each spring.
senses.exampleCN: 每年春天，整个氏族都在祠堂聚会。
senses.why: Scots clann originally meant 'children, family', so the first sense is a family widened to all who claim one ancestor.
senses.whyCN: 苏格兰语 clann 原意是「子女、家族」，因此第一义就是把家庭扩展到所有自称同祖的人。

senses.title: An extended family network
senses.definition: the practical network of relatives who help one another with money, labour and marriages
senses.definitionCN: 在经济、劳力与婚姻上互相帮衬的亲属关系网络
senses.example: The marriage joined two clans that had traded for a century.
senses.exampleCN: 这场婚姻把两个通商百年的家族连在一起。
senses.why: a clan in daily use is less a pedigree than a set of people you can call on, so the kin group becomes a support network.
senses.whyCN: 日常所说的 clan 与其说是一份谱系，不如说是一群可以求助的人，于是血亲团体变成了互助网络。

senses.title: A tribal division under a chief
senses.titleCN: 部落之下由首领统辖的分支
senses.definition: a subdivision of a tribe, usually led by a chief or a council of elders
senses.definitionCN: 部落之下的分支，通常由首领或长老会领导
senses.example: Each clan sent one elder to the tribal council.
senses.exampleCN: 每个氏族派一名长老参加部落议事会。
senses.why: anthropology needed a unit between the single household and the whole tribe, and the old family word took that place.
senses.whyCN: 人类学需要在单户家庭与整个部落之间找一个单位，旧的「家族」词就占了这个位置。

senses.title: A close exclusive faction
senses.definition: a small group of colleagues or friends who promote one another and keep outsiders at a distance
senses.definitionCN: 互相提携、对圈外人保持距离的同事或朋友小圈子
senses.example: The department is run by a clan of people who lunch together.
senses.exampleCN: 这个部门由一个总在一起吃午饭的小圈子把持。
senses.why: the family image is borrowed with irony: the group behaves as if related, and its warmth excludes.
senses.whyCN: 借用了家庭的意象并带讽刺：这群人表现得像亲戚，其温情同时排斥外人。

senses.title: A criminal or street gang
senses.definition: an organized criminal group that protects its members and demands loyalty above the law
senses.definitionCN: 保护成员、要求忠诚高于法律的有组织犯罪团体
senses.example: Police linked the warehouse fire to a clan fighting over the docks.
senses.exampleCN: 警方把仓库大火与一个争夺码头的帮派联系起来。
senses.why: loyalty, silence and inherited membership look like kinship rules, so the word moves easily from family to gang.
senses.whyCN: 忠诚、缄默与世袭身份都像亲属规则，因此这个词很容易从家族滑向帮派。

senses.title: A gaming guild of players
senses.definition: an in-game association of players who share a name, a chat channel and joint activities
senses.definitionCN: 共享名称、聊天频道与集体活动的游戏内玩家组织
senses.example: Our clan meets online every Friday to raid together.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的公会每周五上线，一起团队副本。
senses.why: online groups revive the old feature of a shared name and mutual aid, so players borrowed the word whole.
senses.whyCN: 线上群体恢复了共享名称与互助的旧特点，因此玩家把整个词借了过去。

senses.title: A biological lineage
senses.definition: a set of individuals or cell lines descended from one common ancestor
senses.definitionCN: 由一个共同祖先传下来的个体集合或细胞系
senses.example: All the mice in the study belong to a single clan.
senses.exampleCN: 研究中的全部小鼠都属于同一个世系。
senses.why: genetics kept only the descent component of the word and dropped the social obligations.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学只保留了这个词的「传承」成分，去掉了社会义务。

senses.title: An in-group sharing taste or habit
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：共享品味或习惯的内群体
senses.definition: any loose in-group defined by a shared taste, jargon or routine rather than by kinship
senses.definitionCN: 由共同品味、行话或习惯而非血亲界定出来的松散内群体
senses.example: The film has become a clan of people who quote it daily.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影已经成了一个每天引用台词的圈子。
senses.why: once the word means any close group, kinship can drop out entirely and only the boundary remains.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个词泛指任何紧密群体，血亲关系就可完全脱落，只剩边界。

intro.en: Clan came into English from Scottish Gaelic clann 'children, family', which goes back to Old Irish cland and, through borrowing, to Latin planta 'sprout, plant'.
intro.cn: clan 从苏格兰盖尔语 clann「子女、家族」进入英语，上承古爱尔兰语 cland，再往上经借用关系连到拉丁 planta「芽、植株」。

items.en: Planta meant 'sprout, shoot, plant'; the image is a shoot growing from one stock, which is also how a lineage is pictured.
items.cn: planta 意为「芽、新枝、植株」；意象是从同一根桩上长出的新枝，血统也正以此取象。

items.en: The Latin noun was taken into early Celtic as a word for offspring or family; the exact route is source uncertain, and no single borrowing path is agreed.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词被早期凯尔特语借去，用来指后代或家族；具体路径来源不确定，学界并无一致说法。

items.en: Old Irish cland is recorded with the sense 'family, offspring'; from it comes the Gaelic form that English later took.
items.cn: 古爱尔兰语 cland 有「家族、后代」的义项记录；盖尔语形式即由其而来，英语后来又借入这个盖尔语形式。

items.en: Scottish Gaelic clann kept the meaning 'children, family' and was used for a group claiming one ancestor, without any claim to a separate race.
items.cn: 苏格兰盖尔语 clann 保留「子女、家族」之义，用来指自称同祖的一群人，并不含「另一个种族」的意思。

items.en: English took the word in the late Middle Ages for Highland kin groups; the wider senses of faction and guild are much later extensions.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪晚期借入此词，指高地亲族团体；小集团与公会等更宽的义项是很晚的延伸。

items.en: The sense 'race' sometimes read into the word is a later misunderstanding; dictionaries stress descent and loyalty, not biology.
items.cn: 有时被人读进这个词的「种族」义属后来误解；词典强调的是世系与忠诚，而非生物学。

note.en: Group one holds words whose form is close but whose root is different; group two holds real kin-group terms that differ in scale or in the tie invoked.
note.cn: 第一组是形近而词根不同的词；第二组是真正的亲族词，差别在规模或所诉诸的纽带。

entries.definition: A shellfish or the shell itself; its own origin is source uncertain, and it has no established link to clan beyond a similar shape and short vowel.
entries.definitionCN: 蛤蜊或蛤壳，其自身来源不确定，除拼写与短元音外与 clan 并无确立的联系。

entries.definition: A device that holds things tightly; its origin is not established as the same as clan's, and only the opening sounds coincide.
entries.definitionCN: 夹紧器；其来源是否与 clan 相同并无定论，只共享开头音，不能据此认为同源。

entries.definition: A homophone often confused with clan; the organisation it names is entirely different, and any historical link between the two words is source uncertain.
entries.definitionCN: 与 clan 同音、常被混淆的词；它所称的组织完全不同，两词之间是否有历史联系则来源不确定。

entries.definition: From Greek klōn 'twig, slip', a cutting used to propagate a plant; the 'twig' picture is the only faint echo of clan.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语 klōn「枝条、插穗」，指用来繁殖植物的切枝；只有「枝条」意象与 clan 隐约相像。

entries.definition: A larger group of clans or bands united by a common name and leadership; a clan is one unit inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 由多个氏族或部落分支联合而成、共享名称与领导的更大群体；clan 是其中一个单位。

entries.definition: A line of descent traced from an ancestor; it stresses genealogy and may have no corporate action or territory.
entries.definitionCN: 从某位祖先追下来的世系；强调谱系，未必有集体行动或领地。

entries.definition: One's relatives taken together, without a clan name, a chief or a common ritual.
entries.definitionCN: 一个人全部亲属的集合，没有氏族名称、首领或共同仪式。

entries.definition: Relatives beyond the nuclear household who cooperate in daily life; the term is domestic, while a clan may hold land and feuds.
entries.definitionCN: 核心家庭之外、在日常生活中互助的亲属；这个词属家庭层面，而氏族可拥有土地与世仇。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Gaelic source, the Latin plant image, and the words English built on clan.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的盖尔语来源、拉丁「植株」意象，以及英语在 clan 之上造出的词。

normal.en: Gaelic clann 'children': a clan is a family written large.
normal.cn: 盖尔语 clann「子女」：氏族就是一个放大了的家庭。

normal.en: Latin planta 'sprout' sits at the far end of the borrowing chain: one stock, many shoots.
normal.cn: 借用链的最远端是拉丁 planta「芽」：一根桩，许多新枝。

normal.en: clan + -ish gives clannish, the everyday adjective for a group that keeps others out.
normal.cn: clan 加 -ish 得到 clannish，是形容群体排外的日常形容词。

normal.en: Clansman and clanship mark the member and the system.
normal.cn: clansman 与 clanship 分别标记成员与制度。

normal.en: The fixed phrase 'the head of the clan' shows how a group is imagined as one body.
normal.cn: 固定搭配「族长」显示这群人被想象成一个身体。

abstract.en: Picture a name that everyone in the room shares and no outsider may use.
abstract.cn: 想象一个名字，屋里人人共有，外人不得使用。

abstract.en: Picture a debt that passes to children who never agreed to it.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔债，传给从未同意过的孩子。

abstract.en: Picture a family tree with roots below the soil, where nobody can see where it began.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵家谱树，根埋在土下，无人看得见它从何处起头。

examples.en: The clan still owns the terraced fields below the village.
examples.cn: 这个氏族至今拥有村下的梯田。

examples.en: In the game, a clan can hold a fortress only if its members log in together.
examples.cn: 在游戏里，公会只有成员一起上线才能占据堡垒。

examples.en: The novelist describes a political clan that treats the ministry as family property.
examples.cn: 小说家描写一个把部委当作家族财产的政治小集团。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克蓝」：一族人都穿同一种蓝布衣，远远一看便知是自己人 → 氏族、家族、抱团的小集团

root: 苏格兰盖尔语 clann「子女、家族」< 古爱尔兰语 cland < 拉丁 planta「芽、植株」（借词链）；现代英语 clan。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses spread outward from one ancestor: a named descent group, then its living network, its place in a tribe, then groups that only imitate kinship, a gang, a gaming guild, a biological line and finally any in-group with a boundary.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一位祖先向外扩散：有名号的世系群体，接着是它活生生的关系网、它在部落中的位置，然后是只模仿亲属关系的群体、帮派、游戏公会、生物世系，最后是任何有边界的内部圈子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one ancestor's name, and everyone who answers to it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个祖先的名字，以及所有应这个名字的人。

chain: PLACE THE GROUP IN A TRIBE

branches.en: DESCENT AND POLITICS: a named kin group and its standing inside a larger tribe.
branches.cn: 世系与政治：有名号的亲族群体，以及它在更大部落中的地位。

branches.en: LIVING NETWORK: the relatives one actually calls on for labour, money and marriage.
branches.cn: 活的关系网：真正能为劳力、金钱与婚姻去求助的那些亲戚。

branches.en: FAMILY IMITATED: factions and gangs borrow the loyalty and silence of kinship.
branches.cn: 被模仿的家庭：小集团与帮派借用了亲属关系的忠诚与缄默。

branches.en: VOLUNTARY BOUNDARY: guilds and taste groups keep the name and the inside/outside line.
branches.cn: 自愿的边界：公会与品味圈子保留了名称与内外界线。

branches.en: PURE LINEAGE: biology keeps only descent and lets the social duties fall away.
branches.cn: 纯世系：生物学只留下传承，让社会义务脱落。

intro.en: Clan itself is a borrowing, so its family is mostly English suffixes added to a Gaelic noun, with a Latin noun at the end of the borrowing chain.
intro.cn: clan 本身是借词，因此它的词族主要是加在这个盖尔语名词上的英语后缀，借用链末端则是一个拉丁名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is planta 'sprout, plant' with its verb plantare; Latin supplies no further relative of English clan except through this borrowing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语一端是 planta「芽、植株」及其动词 plantare；除这条借用链之外，拉丁语并不提供英语 clan 的其他同族词。

items.example: The word entered English with no change of shape.
items.exampleCN: 这个词以原来的形式整体进入英语。

items.meaning: loyal to one's group and cold to outsiders
items.example: The office felt clannish to a new arrival.
items.exampleCN: 新来的人觉得这间办公室很抱团排外。

items.example: The hiring was done clannishly, among cousins.
items.exampleCN: 招聘是在表亲之间抱团完成的。

items.example: Their clannishness kept good applicants away.
items.exampleCN: 他们的抱团排外把优秀申请者挡在门外。

items.example: A clansman carried the chief's banner.
items.exampleCN: 一名氏族成员扛着首领的旗帜。

items.example: Clanship shaped who could vote in the village.
items.exampleCN: 氏族归属决定了村里谁有投票权。

items.example: The Latin noun opens the borrowing chain.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是借用链的起点。

items.structure: plantare, plantavi, plantatum (Latin verb, first conjugation)
items.example: The verb describes putting a shoot into the ground.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指把新枝插进土里。

definition_zh: 清晰发音；明确阐述
definition_en: to pronounce words clearly, or to state an idea in a firm and definite way
core_image: 播音员把每个音节咬得边界分明，话筒前的声音像被刀切过
scene: 台词老师要求学生把每个音节说清楚。 The coach asked every actor to enunciate each syllable.
sceneCN: 这里 enunciate 是「清晰发音」（第 1 个义项：把字音说得分明）；句意：教练要求每位演员把每个音节念清楚。

senses.title: To pronounce words distinctly
senses.definition: to shape the sounds of speech so that each word is heard clearly
senses.definitionCN: 把语音成形，使每个词都听得清楚
senses.example: She enunciates so well that subtitles are unnecessary.
senses.exampleCN: 她吐字极清楚，根本不需要字幕。
senses.why: The Latin stem is about reporting, and clear speech is a report that reaches the listener intact.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词干本义与宣告有关，清楚的吐字就是一份完好送达的报告。

senses.title: To state a doctrine or policy firmly
senses.definition: to express a principle, aim, or rule in definite terms
senses.definitionCN: 用确定的措辞表达原则、目标或规则
senses.example: The charter enunciates three core values.
senses.exampleCN: 章程阐明了三项核心价值。
senses.why: Formal writing transfers the speech sense to statements that must be beyond doubt.
senses.whyCN: 正式书面语把吐定义项转移到不容含糊的声明上。

intro.en: Enunciate joins a prefix of out to Latin nuntiare, to report, from nuntius, a messenger.
intro.cn: enunciate 由表出的前缀加拉丁语 nuntiare（报告）构成，nuntius 指信使。

items.en: Nuntius means messenger or report.
items.cn: nuntius 指信使或报告。

items.en: Nuntiare means to bring word, and enuntiare to state out.
items.cn: nuntiare 指传信，enuntiare 指明白说出。

items.en: Enuntiatus marks a thing definitely declared.
items.cn: enuntiatus 标记已被明确宣告之事。

items.en: English adopts the verb in rhetorical and elocution texts.
items.cn: 十八世纪英语在修辞与朗读教材中采纳该词。

items.en: Speech therapy keeps the pronunciation sense alive.
items.cn: 现代英语中语音治疗保留发音义。

note.en: Group one holds the nuntiare family; group two holds other verbs of saying clearly.
note.cn: 第一组是 nuntiare 词族；第二组是其他表示说清的动词。

entries.definition: The action noun used in voice training and in formal statements.
entries.definitionCN: 动作名词，用于发声训练与正式声明。

entries.definition: Built on the same report root with a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 同一报告词根搭配别的前缀。

entries.definition: To declare or to shape sounds, the closest rival in speech use.
entries.definitionCN: 宣告或发出字音，是发音义上最近的竞争词。

entries.definition: To accuse publicly, keeping the reporting idea in a hostile direction.
entries.definitionCN: 公开指控，报告义转向敌意方向。

entries.definition: To express coherently, with the image of jointed sounds.
entries.definitionCN: 有条理地表达，取关节分明之音的意象。

entries.definition: The neutral verb for putting something in words.
entries.definitionCN: 用语言表达的中性动词。

entries.definition: To announce formally, closer to the doctrinal sense.
entries.definitionCN: 正式宣告，接近教义阐意义。

entries.definition: A fixed collocation in acting and speech coaching.
entries.definitionCN: 表演与朗读教学中的固定搭配。

normalIntro.en: Enunciate shares its core with nuntiare, to bring word, so think of a message delivered crisply.
normalIntro.cn: enunciate 与 nuntiare（传信）共享核心，可想成一条送达利落的消息。

normal.en: For speech, use it without an object: practice enunciating.
normal.cn: 表发音时可不带宾语：practice enunciating。

normal.en: For ideas, it takes a doctrine, policy, or principle.
normal.cn: 表思想时宾语多为学说、政策或原则。

normal.en: The noun enunciation appears in drama schools.
normal.cn: 名词 enunciation 常出现在戏剧院校。

normal.en: Pronounce is everyday; enunciate stresses clarity.
normal.cn: pronounce 日常，enunciate 强调清晰度。

normal.en: Do not write envelope here; the ending is -ciate.
normal.cn: 不要写成 envelope；词尾是 -ciate。

abstract.en: Picture a metronome ticking each syllable in place.
abstract.cn: 想象节拍器把每个音节敲到位。

abstract.en: Imagine a town crier reading a proclamation aloud.
abstract.cn: 想象报信人当众宣读告示。

abstract.en: Think of glass beads laid out one by one on a tray.
abstract.cn: 想想木盘上一颗颗摆开的玻璃珠。

examples.en: The announcer enunciates every number on the board.
examples.cn: 播音员把板上每个数字都念得清楚。

examples.en: The manifesto enunciates a right to housing.
examples.cn: 宣言明确阐述居住权。

examples.en: Slowing down helps you enunciate better.
examples.cn: 放慢语速有助于吐字更清晰。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一南谁累特」——音近 enunciate，报信的人一路喊到累，所以是清晰宣告；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 nuntius（信使）→ nuntiare（报告）→ enuntiare（明白宣告）→ 英语 enunciate，核心义「把话说清、把义宣明」。

sensesIntro.en: One sense lives in the mouth and the other in official writing, both demanding distinctness.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个义项在口中，一个在公文里，两者都要求分明。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a message spoken so cleanly that nothing is smudged.
core.cn: 核心意象：话说得极干净，绝无模糊之处。

branches.en: Physical articulation is the concrete sense.
branches.cn: 口部发音是具体义项。

branches.en: Formal statements borrow the same distinctness.
branches.cn: 正式声明借用同一分明特质。

branches.en: Both require that the receiver hear without effort.
branches.cn: 两者都要求听者毫不费力地接收。

branches.en: Voice training keeps only the muscular sense.
branches.cn: 发声训练只保留肌肉层面的义项。

branches.en: Legal and political prose keep the declaring sense.
branches.cn: 法律与政治文体保留宣告义项。

intro.en: A Latin prefix of out plus a stem of reporting takes English verbal endings.
intro.cn: 拉丁语表出的前缀加报告词干，再取英语动词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin Nuntius is messenger, nuntiare is to report, and nuncupare is to name aloud.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 nuntius 指信使，nuntiare 指报告，nuncupare 指高声命名。

items.exampleCN: e- 标记说出这一动作。

definition_zh: 赎回；弥补；兑换；救赎；履行（诺言）
definition_en: to buy back, to make good, to exchange a token, to save from sin, or to carry out a promise
core_image: 当铺柜台上，一块旧怀表被推回主人手里，旁边压着刚付清的当票
scene: 当铺里那块怀表被主人用多出一成的钱取了回来。 He redeemed the watch from the pawnshop before the month was out.
sceneCN: 这里 redeem 指赎回（第 1 个义项：付钱把抵押出去的东西取回）；句意为月底之前，他用钱把那块表从当铺赎回。

senses.title: To redeem a pledge
senses.definition: to buy back something given as security for a loan
senses.definitionCN: 付钱取回为借款而抵押出去的东西
senses.example: He redeemed the watch from the pawnshop before the month was out.
senses.exampleCN: 月底之前，他把那块表从当铺赎回。
senses.why: The first sense is the oldest: money is paid and the object comes home.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项最古老：钱付出去，东西回家。

senses.title: To redeem a fault
senses.definition: to make good a failure or an offence by some counterweight
senses.definitionCN: 用某种补偿把失败或过失抵消掉
senses.example: One honest report redeemed a year of careless work.
senses.exampleCN: 一份诚实的报告弥补了一整年的粗心工作。
senses.why: Here the thing bought back is not an object but a reputation.
senses.whyCN: 这里赎回来的不是物件，而是名声。

senses.title: To redeem a coupon
senses.definition: to exchange a token, voucher or points for goods or value
senses.definitionCN: 用票券、代金券或积分换取商品或价值
senses.example: The voucher can be redeemed at any branch.
senses.exampleCN: 这张代金券可在任何分店兑换。
senses.why: Commerce keeps the paying image inside a paper token.
senses.whyCN: 商业把「付钱」的意象留在一张纸券里。

senses.title: To redeem a sinner
senses.definition: in religious use, to save a person from sin or its penalty
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教用法中，指把人从罪或其惩罚中救出来
senses.example: The preacher said no one was beyond being redeemed.
senses.exampleCN: 牧师说没有人是救不回来的。
senses.why: Theology turns the buying back into a rescue of the soul.
senses.whyCN: 神学把「赎回」变成对灵魂的营救。

senses.title: To redeem a promise
senses.definition: to carry out a pledge or fulfil an undertaking
senses.definitionCN: 兑现一项保证或完成一项承诺
senses.example: He redeemed his promise with a single phone call.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一通电话履行了自己的诺言。
senses.why: A promise is treated as a debt that must be paid.
senses.whyCN: 诺言被当作一笔必须偿还的债。

intro.en: Redeem comes from Latin redimere, 'to buy back', from re- and emere, 'to buy'.
intro.cn: redeem 来自拉丁语 redimere（买回来），由 re- 加 emere（买）构成。

items.en: Emere meant to buy.
items.cn: emere 意为买。

items.en: The compound meant to buy a thing back.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为把东西买回来。

items.en: English used it for buying back pledges.
items.cn: 英语用它指赎回抵押物。

items.en: The church made it the word for salvation.
items.cn: 教会让它成为「救赎」的词。

items.en: Shops now use it for coupons and points.
items.cn: 商店现在用它说优惠券与积分。

note.en: The look-alike group is the redeem- family; the near-meaning group separates ransom, compensate, honour and reclaim.
note.cn: 形近组是 redeem 词族；近义组把「赎金赎回」「补偿」「兑现（承诺）」「讨回」分开。

entries.definition: the act of buying back.
entries.definitionCN: 买回的行为。

entries.definition: able to be bought back or exchanged.
entries.definitionCN: 可赎回或可兑换的。

entries.definition: one who buys back or saves.
entries.definitionCN: 赎回者或救赎者。

entries.definition: serving to save or make good.
entries.definitionCN: 起拯救或弥补作用的。

entries.definition: to pay for the release of a captive.
entries.definitionCN: 付钱赎出被扣者。

entries.definition: to make up for a loss.
entries.definitionCN: 弥补损失。

entries.definition: to keep a promise or an agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 信守承诺或协议。

entries.definition: to demand the return of one's own.
entries.definitionCN: 要求归还原属自己的东西。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a pawn ticket and a watch sliding back across the counter.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一张当票，一块表从柜台那边滑回来」的画面。

normal.en: Redeem is re plus emere, to buy back.
normal.cn: redeem 是 re 加 emere：买回来。

normal.en: Picture the watch passing back across the counter.
normal.cn: 想象那块表从柜台那头滑了回来。

normal.en: Say rih-DEEM; the long vowel is the price paid.
normal.cn: 读 rih-DEEM，长元音就是付出的价钱。

normal.en: The word buys back objects, reputations, souls and promises.
normal.cn: 这个词买回物品、名声、灵魂和诺言。

normal.en: Ask who pays and who is freed when the sum clears.
normal.cn: 问这笔钱结清时，谁付了钱，谁得到了自由。

abstract.en: To redeem is to convert guilt into a receipt.
abstract.cn: 赎回就是把罪疚换成一张收据。

abstract.en: Every redemption assumes that what was lost can still be priced.
abstract.cn: 每一次救赎都预设失去之物仍然可以被标价。

abstract.en: The oldest meaning survives in the newest coupon.
abstract.cn: 最古老的意思活在最时髦的优惠券里。

examples.en: He redeemed the watch from the pawnshop before the month was out.
examples.cn: 月底之前，他把那块表从当铺赎回。

examples.en: One honest report redeemed a year of careless work.
examples.cn: 一份诚实的报告弥补了一整年的粗心工作。

examples.en: The voucher can be redeemed at any branch.
examples.cn: 这张代金券可在任何分店兑换。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ deem（买）→ 付钱把东西买回来。

root: 拉丁语 redimere（买回来）→ re- + emere（买）

sensesIntro.en: Five senses all pay a price: for an object, a reputation, a token, a soul, and a promise.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都在付一笔价钱：为一件物、一份名声、一张券、一个灵魂，以及一句诺言。

core.en: THE PLEDGE PAID AND RETURNED
core.cn: 赎清并取回的当物

branches.en: An object bought back with money.
branches.cn: 用钱买回来的物品。

branches.en: A reputation bought back with good work.
branches.cn: 用好工作买回的名声。

branches.en: A paper token exchanged for value.
branches.cn: 换成实物的纸券。

branches.en: A soul bought back from sin.
branches.cn: 从罪里被买回的灵魂。

branches.en: A fault and a promise are both debts.
branches.cn: 过失与诺言都是债。

intro.en: The redeem- family is about buying back: redemption, redeemable, redeemer and redemptive all keep the counter and the price.
intro.cn: redeem 词族讲的是买回：redemption、redeemable、redeemer、redemptive 都保留柜台与价钱的意象。

latinIntro.en: Latin emere, 'to buy', gives redimere, 'to buy back'; redemption is the noun of that transaction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 emere（买）生出 redimere（买回来）；redemption 是这笔交易的名词形式。

definition_zh: 贫血；贫血症；（比喻）缺乏活力、萎靡不振
definition_en: a condition in which the blood lacks enough healthy red cells, causing weakness; a lack of vitality
core_image: 脸色苍白、爬两层楼就喘的人：血里少了提气的红细胞
scene: 她最近总是头晕，爬楼梯都费劲。 The doctor said her constant fatigue was caused by anemia, so she needed more iron in her diet.
sceneCN: 这里的 anemia 是「贫血症」（第 1 个义项：血液中健康红细胞不足）；句意是医生说她持续的疲劳由贫血引起，需要补铁。

derivatives.zh: 由 anemia 加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「贫血的；苍白无力的」
由 anemic 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「贫血地；苍白无力地」

senses.title: A lack of healthy red blood cells
senses.definition: a medical condition in which the blood has too few healthy red cells or too little hemoglobin, causing tiredness and pallor
senses.definitionCN: 血液中健康红细胞或血红蛋白过少的病症，导致疲倦、脸色苍白
senses.example: Heavy periods are a common cause of anemia in young women.
senses.exampleCN: 月经过多是年轻女性贫血的常见原因。
senses.why: The Greek prefix an- means without and haima means blood, so the term literally names a bloodless, blood-poor state.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语前缀 an- 表示「没有」，haima 表示「血」，术语字面就是「缺血、血少」的状态。

senses.title: A lack of vitality or strength
senses.definition: a weakness or lack of vigor in something such as an economy, a team, or a piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 比喻经济、队伍、文章等缺乏生气与力度
senses.example: The report described the anemia of the housing market.
senses.exampleCN: 报告描述了房地产市场的萎靡不振。
senses.why: A pale, tired patient gave writers a ready image of weak, colorless performance, so the medical word turned figurative.
senses.whyCN: 苍白疲倦的病人给写作者提供了现成的「无力、无血色」意象，医学术语因此转出比喻义。

intro.en: Anemia is a Greek medical compound: an- without plus haima blood.
intro.cn: anemia 是希腊医学复合词：an-（没有）加 haima（血）。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ai- or *sai- referred to vital fluid; its descendants include haima and related blood words.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ai- / *sai- 与生命液体有关，其后续形式包括希腊语 haima 等表示「血」的词。

items.en: Greek haima meant blood, and the compound anaimia named the condition of being without blood, that is, blood-poor.
items.cn: 希腊语 haima 意为「血」，复合词 anaimia 表示「无血、缺血」的状态。

items.en: Medical Latin revived the compound as anaemia when doctors systematized Greek terms.
items.cn: 医生们系统化希腊术语时，医学拉丁语以 anaemia 复兴了这个复合词。

items.en: English anemia is recorded from the early 1800s in medical writing.
items.cn: 英语 anemia 自 19 世纪初见于医学文献。

items.en: By the late 19th century the word had also taken the figurative sense of any lack of vigor.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪后期，该词也发展出「缺乏活力」的比喻义。

note.en: Anemia is often confused with anorexia in form; its adjectives anemic and anaemic differ by spelling system.
note.cn: anemia 易与 anorexia 在字形上混淆；形容词 anemic 与 anaemic 是美式与英式拼法。

entries.definition: an eating disorder or loss of appetite
entries.definitionCN: 厌食（症），同为 an- 开头的医学词，但词根不同，仅拼写相近

entries.definition: relating to or suffering from anemia; weak and pale
entries.definitionCN: 贫血的；（比喻）苍白无力的，由 anemia 派生的形容词

entries.definition: loss of sensation, British spelling
entries.definitionCN: 麻醉；感觉缺失，英式拼法，与 anemia 同以 ana- 开头但词根不同

entries.definition: something intensely detested
entries.definitionCN: 令人憎恶之物，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: extreme tiredness
entries.definitionCN: 疲劳，是贫血的主要症状而非病症本身

entries.definition: a lack of energy and enthusiasm
entries.definitionCN: 倦怠；无精打采，与比喻义相近

entries.definition: a state of having no energy or interest
entries.definitionCN: 无精打采，与比喻义相近

entries.definition: the state of being weak
entries.definitionCN: 虚弱；无力，泛指力量不足

entries.definition: an unhealthy pale appearance
entries.definitionCN: 苍白（面色），贫血的典型表征

normalIntro.en: Remember anemia as an- plus haima, without blood.
normalIntro.cn: 把 anemia 记成 an- 加 haima，就是「缺血」。

normal.en: an- means without, seen in anonymous and anarchy.
normal.cn: 前缀 an- 表示「没有」，见于 anonymous、anarchy。

normal.en: haima is the Greek word for blood, kept in hemoglobin.
normal.cn: haima 是希腊语「血」，保留在 hemoglobin（血红蛋白）一词中。

normal.en: So anemia literally means a blood-poor state.
normal.cn: 所以 anemia 字面意思就是「血少」的状态。

normal.en: hematology, the study of blood, shares the same root.
normal.cn: hematology（血液学）用的就是同一个「血」词根。

normal.en: The adjective anemic also means weak or unimpressive.
normal.cn: 形容词 anemic 也表示「软弱无力的、不痛不痒的」。

abstract.en: Picture a pale runner who has to stop halfway up the stairs.
abstract.cn: 想象一个脸色苍白的跑者，爬楼梯爬到一半就停下了。

abstract.en: See a wilting plant that has not been watered for weeks.
abstract.cn: 想象一株几周没浇水的植物，蔫蔫地垂着。

abstract.en: Feel a flat, colorless speech that puts the whole room to sleep.
abstract.cn: 感受一场苍白无力的演讲，让全场昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with iron-deficiency anemia last winter.
examples.cn: 去年冬天她被诊断出缺铁性贫血。

examples.en: An anemic performance in the first half cost the team the match.
examples.cn: 上半场软绵绵的表现让球队输掉了比赛。

examples.en: Common symptoms of anemia include dizziness and pale skin.
examples.cn: 贫血的常见症状包括头晕和面色苍白。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额·腻·咪·呀」——额头像抹了腻子一样没有血色，咪着眼喊呀好累：anemia，贫血。

root: 希腊语否定前缀 an-（无）+ haima（血，词根 *ai-/*sai- 与生命液体相关）→ anaimia「缺血状态」，经医学拉丁语 anaemia 进入英语。同族词 hemoglobin（血红蛋白）、hematology（血液学）。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the blood condition to the figurative lack of vigor.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「血液病症」出发，引申为「缺乏生气的比喻用法」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: blood gone thin, body gone pale and weak
core.cn: 核心意象：血变稀薄，人变得苍白无力

branches.en: The medical state of too few red cells
branches.cn: 红细胞过少的医学病症

branches.en: The visible signs of tiredness and pallor
branches.cn: 疲倦与苍白的外在表征

branches.en: Weak colorless performance by analogy
branches.cn: 类比而来的软弱无色的表现

branches.en: A sluggish economy or market
branches.cn: 萎靡的经济或市场

branches.en: From thin blood to thin energy
branches.cn: 从血薄到「气」薄的引申路径

intro.en: Anemia is a transparent Greek compound: negative prefix plus the blood root.
intro.cn: anemia 是透明的希腊语复合词：否定前缀加「血」词根。

latinIntro.en: The haim- family of Greek medical words is large and systematic.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊医学词的 haim- 词族庞大而系统。

definition_zh: 渗透性；渗透率；磁导率；（膜的）通透性
definition_en: the degree to which a material allows a fluid, field or substance to pass through it
core_image: 两根并排的砂柱与黏土柱，同一压力下水面下降速度截然不同，刻度尺记录差距
scene: 同样的压力下，水在砂柱中下降得远比在黏土柱中快，仪器把这一差别记成数值。 At equal pressure, water sinks much faster through the sand column, and the test reports that difference as permeability.
sceneCN: 这里 permeability 指「材料允许流体通过的程度」（第 1 个义项：以流量与压力差之比衡量的渗透能力）；句意为同一压力下水在砂柱中下降更快，试验把这一差别记为渗透性。可辨识物件：砂柱、黏土柱、水位刻度、压力装置。

forms.label: 复数（指多种渗透性，罕用）

senses.title: The general property
senses.titleCN: 渗透性：让流体通过的能力
senses.definition: the property of a material that allows a fluid to move through its pores or structure
senses.definitionCN: 材料允许流体通过其孔隙或结构的属性
senses.example: The permeability of the soil decides how fast rain disappears.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤的渗透性决定雨水消失得多快。
senses.why: This is the abstract noun of permeable: the adjective says a thing can be crossed, the noun names that capacity as a measurable quantity.
senses.whyCN: 这是 permeable 的抽象名词：形容词说某物可被穿过，名词把这种能力命名为可测量的量。

senses.title: Permeability as a rock parameter
senses.titleCN: 渗透率：达西定律中的参数
senses.definition: the coefficient in Darcy's law that expresses how readily a porous medium transmits a fluid
senses.definitionCN: 达西定律中表示多孔介质导流难易程度的系数
senses.example: The core sample has a permeability of one darcy.
senses.exampleCN: 岩芯样品的渗透率为一达西。
senses.why: Once flow is written as a law, the material needs a number in the equation, and that number is what the noun denotes in petroleum and hydrogeology.
senses.whyCN: 一旦流动被写成定律，材料就必须在方程中有一个数值，而这个数值就是石油与水文地质中该名词所指。

senses.title: Hydraulic conductivity
senses.titleCN: 渗透系数：工程上的传导度
senses.definition: the field-scale measure of how easily water moves through soil, combining the medium and the fluid
senses.definitionCN: 在场地尺度上衡量水穿过土壤难易的指标，兼含介质与流体性质
senses.example: Engineers quote permeability as metres per second in the site report.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师在场地报告中以米每秒给出渗透系数。
senses.why: Field practice needs a rate, not a pure material constant, so the same word is used for the combined quantity that predicts drawdown.
senses.whyCN: 现场实践需要的是速率，而不是纯材料常数，因此同一个词也用来指能预测降深的综合量。

senses.title: Magnetic permeability
senses.titleCN: 磁导率：材料对磁场的响应
senses.definition: the ratio of magnetic flux density to magnetic field strength in a medium
senses.definitionCN: 介质中磁通密度与磁场强度之比
senses.example: Iron has a much higher permeability than air.
senses.exampleCN: 铁的磁导率远高于空气。
senses.why: The concept transfers from water to fields: a medium either lets the influence pass easily or resists it.
senses.whyCN: 这一概念从水迁移到场：介质要么让影响容易通过，要么对它有所抵抗。

senses.title: Membrane permeability
senses.titleCN: 膜通透性：生物膜的选择性
senses.definition: the ease with which substances cross a cell membrane or artificial membrane
senses.definitionCN: 物质穿过细胞膜或人工膜的难易程度
senses.example: Cold increases the permeability of the cell membrane.
senses.exampleCN: 低温会提高细胞膜的通透性。
senses.why: In biology the property is selective and adjustable: the membrane changes what it lets through as conditions change.
senses.whyCN: 在生物学中这一属性是选择性的、可调的：条件变化时膜会改变它放行的东西。

senses.title: Relative permeability
senses.titleCN: 相对渗透率：多相共存时
senses.definition: the reduced permeability of one fluid when another fluid also occupies the pores
senses.definitionCN: 当另一种流体也占据孔隙时，某一种流体的有效渗透率折减
senses.example: Relative permeability falls sharply as water fills the pores.
senses.exampleCN: 水充满孔隙时，相对渗透率急剧下降。
senses.why: Two fluids compete for the same passages, so each one's ability to move depends on how much space the other has taken.
senses.whyCN: 两种流体争夺同一批通道，因此每一种的流动能力都取决于另一种占去了多少空间。

senses.title: A classification index
senses.definition: a measured value used to classify soils and rocks for engineering design
senses.definitionCN: 用于工程设计中的土石分类的实测值
senses.example: The consultant classified the site by permeability and grain size.
senses.exampleCN: 顾问按渗透性与粒径对场地进行分类。
senses.why: A single number can sort materials into groups, so permeability becomes part of the vocabulary of classification rather than of flow alone.
senses.whyCN: 一个数值就能把材料分成组，因此渗透性不只属于流动，也成了分类词汇的一部分。

senses.title: Abstract: susceptibility
senses.definition: the degree to which a system or person admits outside influence
senses.definitionCN: 系统或人容纳外界影响的程度
senses.example: The committee's permeability to lobbyists became a public issue.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会对游说者的易受影响程度成了公共议题。
senses.why: The measurement language carries over neatly: influence has a flow, defences have a resistance, and the ratio can be estimated.
senses.whyCN: 测量语言可以整齐地迁移过来：影响有流量，防御有阻力，而两者的比值可以被估计。

intro.en: Permeability is the abstract noun of permeable, formed with the Latin suffix -itas, which English renders as -ity. The technical senses were added later. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: permeability 是 permeable 的抽象名词，用拉丁后缀 -itas 构成，英语作 -ity。技术义项是后来附加的。年代为约数。

items.en: Meare, to pass, gives the core idea; the same verb underlies permeare, to pass through, and the noun meatus, a passage.
items.cn: meare「通过」给出核心意思；同一动词构成 permeare「穿过」与名词 meatus「通道」。

items.en: The suffix -itas named a quality, and French -ité and English -ity continue it, which is why the noun ends in -bility rather than -bleness.
items.cn: 后缀 -itas 命名一种性质，法语 -ité 与英语 -ity 延续了它，所以这个名词以 -bility 结尾，而不是 -bleness。

items.en: Medieval Latin permeabilitas paired the adjective with the quality suffix, and English borrowed the pattern rather than inventing a new one.
items.cn: 中古拉丁语 permeabilitas 把形容词与性质后缀配对，英语沿用了这一模式，而非另造新形式。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word acquired precise measured senses in magnetism and in the flow of fluids through porous media.
items.cn: 十九世纪，这个词在磁学与流体穿过多孔介质的研究中获得了精确的测量义。

items.en: Source uncertain (first technical use): the exact date when permeability was first used as a measured magnetic or hydraulic quantity is not fixed in standard references.
items.cn: 来源不确定（技术义首见）：permeability 首次作为可测的磁学量或水力量的确切年代未被通行资料确定。

note.en: The first group holds the derived forms that are easiest to mix up; the second holds quantities and properties that neighbour permeability without being the same measurement.
note.cn: 第一组是最易混淆的派生形式；第二组是与渗透性相邻但并非同一测量的量与属性。

entries.definition: A rare synonym built with the native -ness; the technical noun uses the Latin -ity instead.
entries.definitionCN: 用本族后缀 -ness 构成的罕用同义词；技术名词则用拉丁 -ity。

entries.definition: The same noun with im-, meaning the inability to be passed through.
entries.definitionCN: 同一名词加 im-，表示不能被穿过。

entries.definition: The quality of allowing passage, but built on Latin via, a way, not on meare.
entries.definitionCN: 允许通过的性质，但构自拉丁语 via「道路」，而非 meare。

entries.definition: The fraction of the volume that is pore space; high porosity does not guarantee high permeability.
entries.definitionCN: 孔隙所占的体积比例；孔隙率高并不保证渗透性高。

entries.definition: The ability of a medium to carry a flow; hydraulic conductivity is permeability expressed with fluid properties included.
entries.definitionCN: 介质输导流动的能力；水力传导度是包含流体性质后的渗透性表达。

entries.definition: Permeability multiplied by the thickness of the aquifer, a property of the whole layer.
entries.definitionCN: 渗透性乘以含水层厚度，是整个岩层的属性。

entries.definition: The electric counterpart of magnetic permeability, describing a medium's response to an electric field.
entries.definitionCN: 磁导率的电学对应量，描述介质对电场的响应。

entries.definition: The degree of being affected; it shares the measurement frame but not the porous image.
entries.definitionCN: 受影响的容易程度；它共享测量框架，但没有多孔意象。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the -ity suffix, the four fields that borrow the word, and the real distinction from porosity.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：-ity 后缀、借用这个词的四个领域，以及与孔隙率的真实区别。

normal.en: -ity turns an adjective into a measurable quality, as in porosity and conductivity.
normal.cn: -ity 把形容词变成可测的性质，如孔隙率与传导度。

normal.en: The word is used in four fields: soil water, petroleum, magnetism and cell membranes.
normal.cn: 这个词用于四个领域：土壤水、石油、磁学与细胞膜。

normal.en: Porosity asks how much empty space there is; permeability asks whether the spaces connect.
normal.cn: 孔隙率问有多少空隙；渗透性问这些空隙是否连通。

normal.en: In Darcy's law the permeability is the material's own number, with the fluid accounted separately.
normal.cn: 在达西定律中，渗透率是材料自身的数值，流体性质另行计入。

normal.en: Relative permeability exists because two fluids cannot both use the whole pore space.
normal.cn: 相对渗透率之所以存在，是因为两种流体无法同时占满全部孔隙。

abstract.en: Abstractly, permeability is the ratio of what gets through to what pushes: a measure of openness under pressure.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，渗透性是「通过的量」与「推动的力」之比：压力下开放程度的度量。

abstract.en: It is a property that only appears in relation: the same wall is permeable to air and sealed to water.
abstract.cn: 它是一种只在关系中显现的属性：同一堵墙对空气开放，对水却密封。

abstract.en: Any boundary can be described this way, which is why the word slips so easily from rock to law and to people.
abstract.cn: 任何边界都可以这样描述，所以这个词能轻易从岩石滑向法律与人。

examples.en: Permeability, not porosity, controls how quickly a well can be refilled.
examples.cn: 决定一口井能多快回水的是渗透性，而不是孔隙率。

examples.en: The membrane's permeability to potassium changes when the cell is excited.
examples.cn: 细胞兴奋时，膜对钾的通透性会改变。

examples.en: Steel's high magnetic permeability is why it is used in transformer cores.
examples.cn: 钢的高磁导率正是它被用于变压器铁芯的原因。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泼米啊（permea）+ 比例（-bility）」——水能穿过去多少，要用数值量出来 → 渗透性

root: 拉丁语 per-「穿过」+ meare「通过」+ -itas（性质后缀，英语作 -ity）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses measure one capacity: the general property, the rock constant, the field rate, the magnetic ratio, the membrane's selectivity, the multi-fluid case, the classification index, and finally the susceptibility of a system.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在度量同一种能力：一般属性、岩石常数、场地速率、磁学比值、膜的选择性、多流体情形、分类指标，最后是系统的易受影响程度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two columns under one pressure, water falling fast in sand and slowly in clay.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一压力下的两根柱子，水在砂中落得快、在黏土中落得慢。

branches.en: PROPERTY AND CONSTANT: the capacity becomes a number in Darcy's law.
branches.cn: 属性与常数：这种能力在达西定律中变成一个数值。

branches.en: FIELD RATE: engineers need metres per second, so the constant is combined with the fluid.
branches.cn: 场地速率：工程师需要米每秒，于是常数与流体性质合并。

branches.en: FIELD VERSION: magnetism reuses the same ratio for a different medium.
branches.cn: 场论版本：磁学把同一比值用于另一种介质。

branches.en: SELECTIVITY AND COMPETITION: membranes choose, and two fluids share the same pores.
branches.cn: 选择与竞争：膜做选择，而两种流体共用同一批孔隙。

branches.en: INDEX AND METAPHOR: the number classifies materials, and the same number rates openness in people and institutions.
branches.cn: 指标与比喻：这个数值给材料分类，也用同一数值评价人与机构的开放程度。

intro.en: Permeability shares its stem with permeable and adds the Latin quality suffix; the family is regular enough to predict each member.
intro.cn: permeability 与 permeable 共享词干，并加上拉丁性质后缀；这个词族足够规则，可以预测每个成员。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Latin meare, to pass, with per- through. The quality suffix -itas appears in English as -ity, and the same pattern produces conductivity and porosity.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是拉丁语 meare「通过」，配 per-「穿过」。性质后缀 -itas 在英语中作 -ity，同一模式也构成 conductivity 与 porosity。

items.exampleCN: 渗透率以达西为单位测量。

items.meaning: the quality of not being passable
items.example: The clay's impermeability keeps the pond full.
items.exampleCN: 黏土的不透水性让池塘蓄得住水。

items.example: The permeameter tests each core sample.
items.exampleCN: 渗透仪测试每一块岩芯样品。

items.meaning: the share of volume that is pore space
items.example: Porosity is high but permeability is low in this shale.
items.exampleCN: 这种页岩孔隙率高，但渗透性低。

items.meaning: the ability to carry a flow
items.example: Hydraulic conductivity includes the fluid's viscosity.
items.exampleCN: 水力传导度包含流体的黏度。

items.meaningCN: 渗透性乘以含水层厚度
items.exampleCN: 导水系数描述的是整个岩层。

items.meaning: the electric analogue of magnetic permeability
items.example: Permittivity governs charge in a medium.
items.exampleCN: 介电常数决定介质中的电荷行为。

latinEntries.meaning: passableness, the quality of being passable

definition_zh: 在一定程度上；多少有些；部分地
definition_en: partly; to a limited or uncertain degree
core_image: 审稿人先点头认可结论，又在页边写下「样本偏小」几个字
scene: 审稿人先说结论大体站得住，随后在页边注明样本偏小。 To some extent, the conclusion holds for small cities.
sceneCN: 这里指结论只在有限程度上成立（第 1 个义项：在一定程度上）；句意为该结论在一定程度上适用于小城市。图中可辨识物件：审稿单、页边批注、钢笔、样本表。

pos.zh: 副词性短语：在一定程度上；多少有些

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁分词进入英语，义为「程度；范围；广度」
同一词根的动词，义为「延伸；扩展；延长」
由该动词加名词词尾构成，义为「延伸；扩展部分」
由该词根加形容词词尾构成，义为「广泛的；大量的」
由该形容词加副词词尾构成，义为「广泛地」

senses.title: Partly true
senses.definition: used to say that a statement is true only in part
senses.definitionCN: 用来说明某个说法只有一部分成立
senses.example: To some extent, the criticism is fair.
senses.exampleCN: 在一定程度上，这项批评是公允的。
senses.why: The phrase measures how much of a claim survives, not whether it survives at all.
senses.whyCN: 这条短语衡量一个说法保住了多少，而不是它究竟保没保住。

senses.title: Moderating an adjective
senses.definition: placed before an adjective or adverb to lower the strength of the description
senses.definitionCN: 放在形容词或副词之前，减弱描述强度
senses.example: The results are to some extent predictable.
senses.exampleCN: 这些结果在一定程度上可以预测。
senses.why: A graded property can be true at a lower level, and the phrase supplies that lower level.
senses.whyCN: 可分级属性可以在较低程度上成立，这条短语就提供那个较低的程度。

senses.title: Hedging an academic claim
senses.definition: used in research writing to limit a conclusion without withdrawing it
senses.definitionCN: 在学术写作中限制结论，但不撤回结论
senses.example: To some extent, the model explains the observed pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 在一定程度上，这个模型解释了观察到的规律。
senses.why: Hedging protects a claim from counterexamples while keeping most of its force.
senses.whyCN: 限定让论点在保留大部分力度的同时，免于被反例击破。

senses.title: Sharing blame
senses.definition: used to accept partial responsibility for something that went wrong
senses.definitionCN: 用来说明对出错之事承担部分责任
senses.example: I am to some extent responsible for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 对这次延误，我负有部分责任。
senses.why: Admitting a measured share of blame sounds more credible than denying all of it.
senses.whyCN: 承认有分寸的一份责任，比全盘否认更可信。

senses.title: Limited agreement before an objection
senses.titleCN: 先有限同意再提出异议
senses.definition: used to concede a point before introducing a counterpoint
senses.definitionCN: 在提出相反意见之前先让一步
senses.example: To some extent that is true, but the cost remains too high.
senses.exampleCN: 在一定程度上这是对的，但成本仍然太高。
senses.why: Conceding a little buys room for the objection that follows.
senses.whyCN: 先让出一小步，为后面的反对腾出空间。

senses.title: Applying partly to a whole group
senses.titleCN: 部分地适用于整个群体
senses.definition: used to say that a tendency reaches every member of a group, but only partially
senses.definitionCN: 用来说明某种倾向遍及群体每个成员，但只是部分地
senses.example: To some extent, every city faces the same housing problem.
senses.exampleCN: 在一定程度上，每座城市都面对同样的住房问题。
senses.why: A general statement is softened so that exceptions do not count as refutations.
senses.whyCN: 把全称说法放软，例外就不再构成反驳。

senses.title: Part of a causal contribution
senses.definition: used to say that one factor accounts for only part of a change
senses.definitionCN: 用来说明某个因素只解释了变化的一部分
senses.example: The rise in output is to some extent due to new machinery.
senses.exampleCN: 产量的上升在一定程度上是新机械带来的。
senses.why: Multiple causes share a result, and the phrase assigns one of them a limited share.
senses.whyCN: 多个原因共同造成结果，这条短语给其中一个原因记上有限的一份。

senses.title: A closing concession in argument
senses.definition: used at the end of a point to grant a limited counterpoint and close gracefully
senses.definitionCN: 在一段论证的结尾让出有限的反面，使收尾更从容
senses.example: And to some extent, the critics were right.
senses.exampleCN: 而且在某种程度上，批评者是对的。
senses.why: A concession at the end protects the main claim by showing that it was not overstated.
senses.whyCN: 结尾处的让步表明主论点没有说过头，从而保护了它。

intro.en: The phrase joins to, some and extent. Extent came from Old French estente, from Latin extendere, to stretch out, built from ex-, out, and tendere, to stretch. The phrase became common in English in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
intro.cn: 这条短语由介词、表示「一些」的词与表示「程度」的名词组成。该名词经古法语来自拉丁语 extendere「伸展出去」，由表示「向外」的前缀与表示「拉伸」的词根构成。整条短语在十七、十八世纪的英语中通行起来。

items.en: The verb meant to stretch or strain, and it stands behind tendon, tension and extend.
items.cn: 这个动词意为拉伸、绷紧，是英语中表示肌腱、张力与延伸几个词的源头。

items.en: The compound meant to stretch out or spread, adding a prefix of outward direction.
items.cn: 这个复合动词意为向外伸展、铺开，加了表示向外方向的前缀。

items.en: The French noun named a stretch of land or a degree of something, and English borrowed it as extent.
items.cn: 这个法语名词指一片土地或某事物的程度，英语借入后成为表示程度的名词。

items.en: English first used the noun for size and length, then for the degree to which a quality holds.
items.cn: 英语最初用这个名词指大小与长度，后来指某种性质成立的程度。

items.en: The phrase with to became a standard way of measuring a claim; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 带这个介词的说法成为衡量说法的标准方式；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Later usage produced to a certain extent, to a large extent and the question form to what extent.
items.cn: 后来的用法派生出「在一定程度上」「在很大程度上」以及疑问形式「在多大程度上」。

note.en: The first group shares the root of extent; the second group lists other ways of limiting a claim.
note.cn: 第一组共享「伸展」的词根；第二组是其他限制说法的表达。

entries.definition: The noun for the degree or range of something.
entries.definitionCN: 指某事程度或范围的名词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to stretch out or lengthen.
entries.definitionCN: 指伸展或延长的动词。

entries.definition: The act of extending, or an added part.
entries.definitionCN: 指延伸的行为或增加的部分。

entries.definition: Covering a large area or amount.
entries.definitionCN: 指覆盖面积大或数量多的。

entries.definition: In a wide or thorough manner.
entries.definitionCN: 指广泛地、深入地。

entries.definition: The more formal near twin, common in careful writing.
entries.definitionCN: 更正式的近义说法，多见于谨慎的书面语。

entries.definition: In part, but not wholly.
entries.definitionCN: 指部分地，而非全部。

entries.definition: A one-word degree modifier placed before adjectives.
entries.definitionCN: 放在形容词前的单词程度副词。

entries.definition: For one part of the whole explanation.
entries.definitionCN: 指在整体解释中占一部分。

entries.definition: True only until a limit is reached.
entries.definitionCN: 指只到某个限度为止成立。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the root meaning of stretching out, and the phrase's work of measuring a claim.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用「向外伸展」的词根义，以及这条短语衡量说法的功能。

normal.en: Extent is a stretch, so the phrase measures how far a claim reaches before it stops.
normal.cn: 这个词根是「伸展」，所以短语衡量一个说法伸到多远为止。

normal.en: It sits before an adjective to lower the strength, as in partly predictable.
normal.cn: 它放在形容词前以减弱强度，例如「部分可预测」。

normal.en: Academic writers use it as a hedge, keeping the conclusion while admitting limits.
normal.cn: 学术写作者把它当限定语，在承认局限的同时保住结论。

normal.en: The near twin with certain sounds more formal, and the one with large sounds stronger.
normal.cn: 带「某一」的近义说法更正式，带「很大」的说法程度更强。

normal.en: The question form asks how far, which is the literal meaning of the noun.
normal.cn: 疑问形式问的是「伸到多远」，正是这个名词的字面义。

abstract.en: A claim is a stretch of ground: the phrase marks how much of it can be held.
abstract.cn: 一个说法就像一片地面，这条短语标出能站住多少。

abstract.en: Partial truth is not weak truth; a measured share can be the most defensible position.
abstract.cn: 部分真不等于弱真；有分寸的一份往往是最站得住的立场。

abstract.en: Every general statement needs a dial, and this phrase is the dial turned low.
abstract.cn: 每个全称说法都需要一个旋钮，这条短语就是把旋钮调低。

examples.en: To some extent, the two theories explain the same data.
examples.cn: 在一定程度上，这两种理论解释的是同一批数据。

examples.en: The success of the campaign was to some extent accidental.
examples.cn: 这场运动的成功在一定程度上是偶然的。

examples.en: To some extent, every translation loses the rhythm of the original.
examples.cn: 在一定程度上，每篇译文都会失去原文的节奏。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「吐萨姆埃克斯滕特」——伸手只够到一小段，就是「在一定程度上」：在一定程度上、部分地

root: 这个名词经古法语来自拉丁语 extendere「伸展出去」，由表示「向外」的前缀与表示「拉伸」的词根构成；整条短语在十七、十八世纪通行，确切首见年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses measure a claim, a property, a responsibility, a cause and a concession, all at a reduced degree.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项分别衡量说法、属性、责任、原因与让步，程度都打了折扣。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a reviewer's pen resting in the margin, a note saying the sample is too small.
core.cn: 核心意象：停在页边的审稿笔，以及写着「样本偏小」的批注。

branches.en: THE MEASURED CLAIM: a statement or a property holds only so far.
branches.cn: 被衡量的说法：一个陈述或属性只伸到那么远。

branches.en: THE HEDGE AND THE GROUP: limits on academic claims and on general statements.
branches.cn: 限定与群体：对学术论点与全称说法的限制。

branches.en: THE SHARED BLAME: responsibility is accepted in part.
branches.cn: 分担责任：只接受其中一份责任。

branches.en: THE CONCESSION AND THE CAUSE: a partial agreement, and a partial explanation.
branches.cn: 让步与原因：部分同意，以及部分解释。

branches.en: THE CLOSING NOTE: a limited concession that ends an argument gracefully.
branches.cn: 收尾一笔：用有限的让步从容结束论证。

intro.en: The phrase rests on a Latin verb of stretching, so its core is reach rather than amount.
intro.cn: 这条短语立在一个表示「拉伸」的拉丁动词上，核心是「伸到多远」而非「有多少」。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the verb of stretching and its prefix; Old French supplied the noun that English borrowed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了表示拉伸的词根及其前缀；古法语提供了英语借入的名词。

items.example: The root also stands behind tendon and tension.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也是肌腱与张力二词的源头。

items.example: It turns stretching into stretching out.
items.exampleCN: 它把「拉伸」变成「向外伸展」。
这个动词给出了英语的「延伸」。

items.example: The participle supplied the noun of degree.
items.exampleCN: 其分词提供了表示程度的名词。
英语借入后成为表示程度的名词。

items.example: The noun names how far something reaches.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指某物伸到多远。

items.example: It forms extension, the act of stretching out.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示伸展动作的名词。

items.example: It forms extensive, covering much ground.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示覆盖面广的形容词。

items.example: It keeps the degree deliberately vague.
The whole phrase measures a reduced claim.
items.exampleCN: 整条短语衡量一个被调低的说法。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁分词经古法语而来，义为「程度；范围」
同一词根的动词，义为「延伸；扩展」
加名词词尾构成，义为「延伸；扩展部分」
加形容词词尾构成，义为「广泛的」
加副词词尾构成，义为「广泛地」

definition_zh: n. 自助餐厅，食堂（学校、公司等内部）
definition_en: a self-service restaurant, especially one inside a school, office or hospital
core_image: 一排热菜窗口，人人端着托盘往前走
scene: 员工端着托盘，从热菜窗口一路走到收银台。 The cafeteria queue moved along the hot food counter with trays.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：cafeteria 指自助食堂；句意是员工端着托盘沿着热菜窗口排队前行。

senses.title: A self-service dining room
senses.definition: a room where people take food from counters and pay at the end
senses.definitionCN: 人们从柜台取餐、走到尽头结账的房间
senses.example: We met in the hospital cafeteria at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们中午在医院食堂见面。
senses.why: The Spanish word for a coffee shop was borrowed and shifted to mean self-service dining.
senses.whyCN: 借自西班牙语「咖啡店」，后来转指自助取餐。

senses.title: The food service itself
senses.definition: the catering operation of such a room, or the food it serves
senses.definitionCN: 这类餐厅的餐饮供应或其所供食物
senses.example: The cafeteria closes at two on Fridays.
senses.exampleCN: 食堂周五两点关门。
senses.why: Institutions use the word for the department as well as the room.
senses.whyCN: 机构用这个词既指房间，也指部门。

intro.en: Cafeteria is Spanish for a coffee shop, formed from café plus a suffix for a place.
intro.cn: cafeteria 在西班牙语里是「咖啡店」，由 café 加表示场所的后缀构成。

items.en: Café means coffee, then a coffee house.
items.cn: café 意为咖啡，后指咖啡馆。

items.en: Cafetería means a coffee shop.
items.cn: cafetería 意为咖啡店。

items.en: American English borrows it for self-service dining.
items.cn: 十九世纪美语借来指自助就餐。

items.en: Schools and offices build cafeterias.
items.cn: 二十世纪学校与办公楼普遍设立食堂。

items.en: The tray line becomes the standard layout.
items.cn: 二十世纪托盘流水线成为标准布局。

items.en: Cafeteria means an in-house canteen.
items.cn: 现代指机构内部的食堂。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the caf- opening; the near-meaning group ranks eating places from a canteen to a help-yourself buffet.
note.cn: 形近组共享 caf- 开头；近义组把就餐场所从食堂排到自助餐。

entries.definition: A small coffee house.
entries.definitionCN: 咖啡馆。

entries.definition: The stimulant in coffee.
entries.definitionCN: 咖啡因。

entries.definition: To provide food for an event.
entries.definitionCN: 承办饮食。

entries.definition: A tall pot with a plunger for coffee.
entries.definitionCN: 法式滤压壶。

entries.definition: A dining room in a workplace or school.
entries.definitionCN: 食堂。

entries.definition: A large dining hall in an institution.
entries.definitionCN: 大餐厅。

entries.definition: A meal of dishes set out for self-service.
entries.definitionCN: 自助餐。

entries.definition: A big room used for communal meals.
entries.definitionCN: 餐厅；饭厅。

normalIntro.en: A cafeteria is a café that grew into a queue with trays.
normalIntro.cn: cafeteria 就是从咖啡馆长出来的「托盘队伍」。

normal.en: Café means coffee.
normal.cn: café 意为咖啡。

normal.en: The Spanish ending names a place.
normal.cn: 西班牙语词尾表示场所。

normal.en: So a cafeteria was a coffee place.
normal.cn: 所以它原是「喝咖啡的地方」。

normal.en: Then it became help yourself.
normal.cn: 后来变成「自己取餐」。

normal.en: Now it means the school canteen.
normal.cn: 现在多指学校食堂。

abstract.en: A hundred lunches moving in one direction.
abstract.cn: 一百份午餐朝同一个方向移动。

abstract.en: Warm food behind glass, trays in hand.
abstract.cn: 玻璃后是热菜，手里是托盘。

abstract.en: A room built around the word queue.
abstract.cn: 围绕「排队」一词建起来的房间。

examples.en: The cafeteria serves soup and rice every day.
examples.cn: 食堂每天供应汤和米饭。

examples.en: Students crowded the cafeteria before noon.
examples.cn: 中午前学生就挤满了食堂。

examples.en: The cafeteria is closed during the holiday.
examples.cn: 假期期间食堂关闭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「咖啡厅」的亲戚——先是为咖啡开的地方，后来成了食堂。

root: café（咖啡）+ -tería（场所后缀）→ 供应咖啡与餐食的地方

sensesIntro.en: The room and the service carry the same name because the whole design is a single line from counter to till.
sensesIntro.cn: 房间与服务同名，因为整个设计就是从柜台到收银的一条线路。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: trays moving past glass-fronted hot food
core.cn: 核心意象：托盘沿着玻璃热菜柜向前移动

branches.en: A hospital lunch queue at noon.
branches.cn: 中午医院的午餐队伍。

branches.en: A school room with long tables.
branches.cn: 摆着长桌的学校房间。

branches.en: A counter that closes at two.
branches.cn: 两点就停的取餐台。

branches.en: A menu posted above the till.
branches.cn: 收银台上方贴的菜单。

branches.en: One room, one continuous line.
branches.cn: 一个房间，一条连贯的线。

intro.en: Cafeteria is a Spanish loanword; the list below keeps its café root and adds the vocabulary of meals and service.
intro.cn: cafeteria 是西班牙语借词；下面保留其 café 词根，并补上「餐饮、服务」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Arabic qahwa is coffee, and Latin servire is to serve.
latinIntro.cn: 阿拉伯语 qahwa 意为咖啡，拉丁语 servire 意为服务。

latinEntries.exampleCN: qahwa 产生 café 与 coffee。
servire 产生 service 与 servant。
mensa 产生 canteen 与 mesa。

definition_zh: 令人憎恶的；可恶的；糟透的
definition_en: causing disgust or hatred; extremely bad or unpleasant
core_image: 一盆残羹被打翻，臭味让满桌人捂鼻
scene: 包厢里烟味浓得呛人，邻座还在吞云吐雾。 The passengers endured the abominable smell in the carriage.
sceneCN: 这里 abominable 是「糟透的、令人厌恶的」（第 2 个义项：状况极差令人不适）；句意为乘客们忍受着车厢里恶劣难闻的气味。

pos.zh: 令人憎恶的；可恶的（道德上）
糟透的；恶劣的（程度、状况）

collocations.zh: 雪人（喜马拉雅传说中的怪物）

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「憎恶；痛恨」
同根名词，义为「憎恶之物；可憎的行为」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「可恶地；恶劣地」

senses.title: Morally hateful
senses.definition: deserving strong dislike because it is evil or violates what people hold sacred
senses.definitionCN: 因其邪恶或触犯人们敬重之物而应受强烈憎恶
senses.example: The old law branded such betrayal an abominable crime.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时法律把这种背叛定为可憎的罪行。
senses.why: Folk etymology heard ab homine, away from man; what falls below humanity is hated as less than human.
senses.whyCN: 民间词源把它听成 ab homine「远离人」；堕落到人之下者，被当作非人之物憎恨。

senses.title: Extremely unpleasant in degree
senses.definition: of conditions, behaviour, or quality, extremely bad or unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 指状况、行为或品质极差、令人难受
senses.example: The troops marched through abominable mud and rain.
senses.exampleCN: 部队在糟透的泥泞和冷雨中行军。
senses.why: Hate soaks into everyday life; weather, manners, and smells borrow the strong word for their worst forms.
senses.whyCN: 憎恶渗入日常生活；天气、举止与气味借用这个强烈的词形容它们最坏的形态。

intro.en: Abominable comes from Latin abominari, to deprecate as an ill omen; the ab homine story is a folk myth.
intro.cn: abominable 来自拉丁语 abominari「视为凶兆而远离」；「远离人」的说法是民间讹传。

items.en: A root for omens, os- men-, is reconstructed behind the Latin word.
items.cn: 拉丁词背后重构出一个表示「兆象」的词根 os-men-。

items.en: Abominari meant to avert, to deprecate as an omen of ill.
items.cn: 拉丁语 abominari 意为避开、视之为凶兆而祈禳。

items.en: Ablominable or abominable passed into French learned use.
items.cn: abominable 以学术用法进入古法语。

items.en: English took it for things hateful to God and man.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语借入该词，指神人所憎之事。

items.en: Folk spelling abominable < ab-hominable persisted, feeding the myth.
items.cn: 民间拼法 abominable→ab-hominable 长期存在，助长了讹传。

note.en: Abominable is often mis-split as ab-hominable; its true root speaks of omens.
note.cn: abominable 常被误拆为 ab-hominable；其真正的词根说的是「兆象」。

entries.definition: something loathed
entries.definitionCN: 名词形式，义为憎恶之物

entries.definition: to loathe
entries.definitionCN: 动词形式，义为憎恶

entries.definition: of names; shares letters but comes from nomen
entries.definitionCN: 名义上的；来自 nomen「名字」，词源完全不同

entries.definition: deserving intense dislike
entries.definitionCN: 可憎的；语域相近

entries.definition: arousing disgust or aversion
entries.definitionCN: 令人反感的；偏重生理与心理排斥

entries.definition: shockingly bad or brutal
entries.definitionCN: 恶劣残暴的；常指程度

normalIntro.en: Five anchors tie abominable to the turned-away face.
normalIntro.cn: 五个抓手把 abominable 与扭开的脸绑在一起。

normal.en: a- + bomin(o)- omen: turn from a bad omen.
normal.cn: a- ＋ bomin（兆象）：远离凶兆。

normal.en: Watch out: not ab + human, that is folk myth.
normal.cn: 注意：不是 ab＋human，那是民间讹传。

normal.en: Abominable Snowman is the famous name.
normal.cn: 「雪人」是最著名的用例。

normal.en: abominable weather: British favourite for bad skies.
normal.cn: abominable weather：英国人说天气糟透的口头禅。

normal.en: abomination is the noun to pair.
normal.cn: 配对的名词是 abomination。

abstract.en: Smell spoiled soup and step back.
abstract.cn: 闻到馊汤味，退后半步。

abstract.en: See umbrellas breaking in grey gales.
abstract.cn: 看见雨伞在灰暗的狂风里折断。

abstract.en: Feel eyes narrow at a cruel act.
abstract.cn: 感到目睹恶行时眯起的双眼。

examples.en: Slave trafficking was condemned as an abominable trade.
examples.cn: 贩卖奴隶被斥为可憎的行当。

examples.en: We cancelled the picnic because of abominable weather.
examples.cn: 天气恶劣，我们取消了野餐。

examples.en: His abominable manners cost him every dinner invitation.
examples.cn: 他那糟糕透顶的举止让他失去了所有晚宴邀约。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我报你难啵」——我忍不住报怨：你也太难闻了吧

root: 拉丁语 abominari「视为凶兆而祈禳远离」＝ ab-「离开」＋ omen「兆象」＋ 动词后缀 -ari。「ab homine（远离人）」一说为民间词源讹传。经古法语于十四世纪进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses spread one aversion: from sacred hatred down to everyday awfulness.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项扩展同一种厌恶：从神圣的憎恶降到日常的糟糕。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face turning away and a hand waving off the stench.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张扭开的脸，一只挥散恶臭的手。

branches.en: THE SACRED LINE: what breaks the revered is hated outright.
branches.cn: 神圣之线：触犯敬重之物者遭彻底憎恨。

branches.en: THE WEATHER REPORT: ordinary badness borrows the strong word.
branches.cn: 天气预报：日常的糟糕借用了这个强词。

branches.en: ONE AVERSION: both senses push the face away.
branches.cn: 同一种厌恶：两个义项都把脸扭开。

branches.en: INTENSIFIER ROLE: the word doubles as a strengthener for bad nouns.
branches.cn: 强化语角色：该词兼作强化修饰语。

branches.en: FROM OMENS TO WEATHER: the holy origin still glows beneath common use.
branches.cn: 从兆象到天气：神圣来源在日常用法下仍隐约发光。

intro.en: An omen root with a leaving prefix; the human-split is a false friend.
intro.cn: 兆象词根加离开前缀；「人类」的拆分是假朋友。

latinIntro.en: Latin abominari and omen are classical; the ab-homine derivation is disproved folk lore.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 abominari 与 omen 见于古典文献；ab-homine 的推导已被证明是民间讹传。

items.example: It is wrongly used to split the word.
items.exampleCN: 它被错误地用来拆分该词。

latinEntries.meaning: to deprecate as an ill omen

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「憎恶；痛恨」
同根名词，义为「憎恶之物」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「可恶地；恶劣地」

definition_zh: 风能；由流动空气推动涡轮转化而来的能量
definition_en: energy obtained from moving air, usually converted into electricity by turbines
core_image: 山脊上一排白色风机，叶片在强风中持续转动
scene: 开阔的草原山脊上，白色叶片顺风旋转，把转动送进远处的电网。 A row of turbines turns wind energy into household current.
sceneCN: 这里 wind energy 指「流动空气所携带、可被转化的能量」（第 1 个义项：风推动叶片转动后变成电力或机械功）；句意为山脊上的一排风机把风能变成家庭用电。图中可辨识物件：白色塔筒、旋转叶片、牧场围栏与输电线。

senses.title: Moving air as a source of power
senses.titleCN: 作为动力来源的流动空气
senses.definition: the power carried by air in motion, seen as something that can be captured and put to work
senses.definitionCN: 流动空气所携带的动力，被视为可被捕获并加以利用的东西
senses.example: A row of turbines turns wind energy into household current.
senses.exampleCN: 一排风机把风能变成家庭用电。
senses.why: wind names the moving air and energy names its capacity to do work, so the phrase reads as work-capacity carried by air in motion.
senses.whyCN: wind 指流动的空气，energy 指其做功能力，因此短语读作「流动空气所携带的做功能力」。

senses.title: Electricity from turbines
senses.definition: electric current produced when the turning of turbine blades drives a generator
senses.definitionCN: 涡轮叶片转动带动发电机时产生的电流
senses.example: The grid took wind energy only when the breeze held steady.
senses.exampleCN: 只有风速稳定时，电网才接收风电。
senses.why: the phrase narrows to electricity once the output of a generator is what is being metered and sold.
senses.whyCN: 当被计量与出售的是发电机输出，这个短语就收窄为电力。

senses.title: The resource counted in plans
senses.definition: the wind available over a site, measured and entered into energy plans
senses.definitionCN: 某一地点可获得的风，经测量后计入能源规划
senses.example: Engineers mapped wind energy along the coast for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师用十年时间测绘沿海的风能资源。
senses.why: planners treat a natural flow as a stock to be assessed, so the phrase becomes a quantity on a map.
senses.whyCN: 规划者把自然流动当作可评估的存量，于是这个短语成了地图上的一个量。

senses.title: Mechanical work from wind
senses.definition: the turning force used directly for milling grain, pumping water or sawing wood
senses.definitionCN: 直接用于磨谷、抽水或锯木的转动力
senses.example: The old mill used wind energy to grind wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老磨坊用风能磨小麦。
senses.why: before generators existed, wind did its work through shafts and stones, and this older reading still survives.
senses.whyCN: 在发电机出现之前，风通过轴与石磨做功，这一更早的读法仍然留存。

senses.title: A policy and industry category
senses.definition: the sector, subsidies and regulations built around turning wind into power
senses.definitionCN: 围绕把风变成电力建立的行业、补贴与法规
senses.example: The province set a target for wind energy in its five-year plan.
senses.exampleCN: 该省在五年规划中为风能设定了目标。
senses.why: a flow becomes a category when budgets, permits and jobs are organized around it.
senses.whyCN: 当预算、许可与就业围绕一种流动被组织起来，它就变成一个门类。

senses.title: Kinetic energy in meteorology
senses.definition: the kinetic energy of moving air masses, measured in physical units
senses.definitionCN: 移动气团所具有的动能，以物理单位计量
senses.example: The model estimated wind energy in the lower atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 该模型估算了低层大气中的风能。
senses.why: physics replaces the practical reading with a formula: half the mass times the square of velocity.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把实用读法换成一个公式：质量的一半乘以速度的平方。

senses.title: The emblem of clean power
senses.definition: a symbol in public debate for power that burns no fuel while it runs
senses.definitionCN: 公共讨论中象征运行时不烧燃料的电力
senses.example: The party made wind energy a test of its climate policy.
senses.exampleCN: 该党把风能当作其气候政策的试金石。
senses.why: the fuel is invisible and free, so the phrase easily stands for an environmental position rather than a machine.
senses.whyCN: 燃料看不见又免费，因此这个短语很容易代表一种环保立场，而不只是机器。

senses.title: Any momentum that can be harnessed
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何可被借用的势头
senses.definition: any moving force in a system that can be redirected to do useful work
senses.definitionCN: 系统中任何可被改变方向来做有用功的流动力量
senses.example: The director spoke of wind energy in the crowd's enthusiasm.
senses.exampleCN: 主管把人群的热情称作一股可利用的风能。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps the physical shape: something is already moving, and a device only redirects it.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了物理形态：某物已经在动，装置只负责改变它的方向。

intro.en: Wind energy joins the native English noun wind with Greek energeia 'activity'. The first element is Germanic and the second learned, so the phrase mixes two layers of English vocabulary. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: wind energy 把英语本族名词 wind 与希腊语 energeia「活动」并置。前者属日耳曼层，后者属学术借词层，因此这个短语混合了英语词汇的两个层次。年代均为约数。

items.en: Old English wind meant 'air in motion' and descended from Proto-Germanic *windaz. The same Germanic stock gives Dutch wind and German Wind.
items.cn: 古英语 wind 意为「流动的空气」，源自原始日耳曼语 windaz。同一日耳曼来源也给出荷兰语 wind 与德语 Wind。

items.en: The noun goes back to a root meaning 'to blow', whose exact shape is a reconstruction. Latin ventus 'wind' is a distant cousin from the same root.
items.cn: 这个名词上溯到一个意为「吹」的词根，其确切形态属于重构形式。拉丁语 ventus「风」是同一词根的远亲。

items.en: Energeia meant 'activity, operation', built from en- 'in' and ergon 'work'; Aristotle used it for actuality.
items.cn: energeia 意为「活动、运作」，由 en-「在内」与 ergon「工作」构成；亚里士多德用它指现实。

items.en: Energia entered learned Latin for vigour of style, and physics later fixed energy as the capacity for doing work.
items.cn: energia 进入学术拉丁语指文风力度，物理学后来把 energy 固定为做功的能力。

items.en: Wind energy as a fixed phrase belongs to the age of wind turbines and wind farms, from the late nineteenth century onward.
items.cn: wind energy 作为固定短语属于风力涡轮机与风电场的时代，即 19 世纪末以后。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the exact first printed use of the compound is not recorded, and the Indo-European root behind wind is reconstructed rather than attested.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：这个复合词最早的书证没有确切记录，wind 背后的印欧词根属于重构而非实证。
